methods.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of all 28 sessions with replacement, seed57060, event-weighted mean/positive rate, percentile95%; conditional on selected threshold and OOF models; not selection-adjusted or temporal-regime proof

eventConcentration.semantics: Sum of event bps, not portfolio return; shares can exceed 100% of signed net; absolute and positive denominators are separate.

sessionConcentration.semantics: Sum of event bps, not portfolio return; shares can exceed 100% of signed net; absolute and positive denominators are separate.
sessionConcentration.remainingMeanUnit: Mean of remaining session cumulative bps, not mean event return

directionBias.interpretation: Balanced paired feature rows; bias arises in shared fitted scores, then threshold and state filtering. Direction coefficient affects SHORT vs LONG; directional momentum also matters. No attribution of bias to directional Hybrid selection.

ready.direction: Hybrid direction-neutral; paired LONG/SHORT rows only when feature-ready

blocked.direction: Hybrid direction-neutral; paired LONG/SHORT rows only when feature-ready

marketRegime: UNKNOWN: no precommitted TOPIX/Nikkei/JPX breadth in measurement artifact; no external data fetched
p21Paired: UNKNOWN: no causal prior in audited artifact; no reconstruction attempted

clusterUncertainty.limitations: Negative legacy ICC clipping does not establish event independence. Only28 eval sessions; folds share training history.

immediateAdverse.timeToRecovery: UNKNOWN: stored endpoint labels do not identify first recovery time or within-bar ordering; no new labels generated

originalRuntimeAudit.basis: Fail-closed source, prefix, feature-hash, same-session-label and state-uniqueness assertions; not an independent audit

integrity.limitations: No new raw-source audit; inherited PIT assertions plus feature hash verification, not independent full-market proof

decision.scope: Readiness for a future independent offline validation only; STOP BEFORE OPEN
decision.reason: Positive median and trimmed/winsorized means, positive session-cluster mean interval, and no observed numerical knife-edge across precommitted thresholds justify independent validation. Not a winner claim. Top10 winners account for97.85% of signed net; low coverage and SHORT bias remain material risks. No post-hoc numeric pass thresholds used.
